data.name: Description
data.value: Your own server, NAS or VPS with SSH access and borg installed.

data.name: HostHint
data.value: Host name or IP address, e.g. backup.example.com

data.name: PathHint
data.value: Absolute (/srv/borg/laptop) or relative to the user's home directory (backups/laptop).

data.name: RemoteBorgHint
data.value: Only needed if borg is not simply "borg" on the server, e.g. /usr/local/bin/borg

data.name: HostInvalid
data.value: The server name must not contain spaces, "@", "/" or quotes.

data.name: PortInvalid
data.value: The port must be a number between 1 and 65535.

data.name: UserInvalid
data.value: The user name must not contain spaces, "@", ":", "/" or quotes.

data.name: PathInvalid
data.value: The repository path must not start with "-" or contain quotes, backslashes, "$" or "`".

data.name: RemoteBorgInvalid
data.value: The borg command must not contain spaces, quotes, backslashes, "$" or "`".
